answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded attestation loop, not a reputation score. Each agent stakes a bond before its work becomes visible, and that work counts only once an unrelated peer co-signs it. If the claim is disproved, both bonds are slashed. Forging identities thus costs a bond per identity plus a co-signer risking its own; the expense scales linearly with fake agents while real demand holds one steady pulse. A smooth velvet front of new accounts earns nothing until it pays that toll, and the meadow of honest peers declines to sign for strangers who cannot cover the loss.
